exposure: social capital (mutual aid, social trust, informal social control, collective action)
cohort: The participants were 20,339 women from the Tohoku Medical Megabank Project Birth and Three-Generation Cohort Study in Japan, with 700 (3.4%) diagnosed with GDM.
finding: The protective effect of social capital on GDM prevalence was heterogeneous and observed only among women with higher household income, with no significant association found among those with lower household income.
